purpose: Require explicit item-level Rowan approval before any agent self-update, source promotion, adapter enablement, schema change, permission change, world bridge, theory lens, parser, package, or code modification is applied.

A.label: APPROVE FOR PRODUCTION
A.effect: May proceed only after all declared QA and permission gates pass.

B.label: APPROVE FOR SANDBOX TEST ONLY
B.effect: May run in an isolated sandbox with no canonical writes, source promotion, or private publication.

C.label: APPROVE AS CANDIDATE, DO NOT ENABLE
C.effect: May remain in the candidate registry and receive further evidence, but may not execute or harvest.

D.label: DEFER
D.effect: Keep the proposal unchanged and present it again only when materially new evidence exists.

E.label: DENY
E.effect: Close this proposal version. A materially different future proposal requires a new proposal ID.

F.label: BLOCK SOURCE OR CAPABILITY
F.effect: Add the source or capability to the deny registry until Rowan explicitly reverses the block.

G.label: REQUEST MORE EVIDENCE
G.effect: Do not change the system. Search only for the specific missing evidence and return a revised proposal.

responseSyntax.notesExample: 1B: test for seven days; 2G: confirm licence and rate limit; 3E

renderTemplate: Choices: A production | B sandbox | C candidate only | D defer | E deny | F block | G more evidence
Reply with item choices, for example: 1B, 2G, 3E
